paragraphs.text: Ramiro Alcázar Peniche participated in Shipment ENS-11-03 on 2011-06-23. Red del Horizonte Azul was linked to Shipment ENS-11-03 on 2011-06-23. Shipment ENS-11-03 occurred at Ensenada on 2011-06-23. A warehouse worker in McAllen with a brother employed at an Ensenada seafood exporter reported that Alcázar, the maritime logistics figure known as El Remo, moved 900 kg of cannabis out of Ensenada by sea toward Los Angeles, staged beforehand in the tractor-trailer the crews call Tráiler Luna Parda under paperwork from the seafood firm Mariscos Cabo Norte. The worker stated that the firm's cold storage was used to hold the load until the pangas were ready.

Tráiler Luna Parda was involved in Shipment ENS-11-03 on 2011-06-23. Shipment ENS-11-03 transited Ensenada maritime route on 2011-06-23. Red del Horizonte Azul controlled Ensenada maritime route from 2010-05-30 until 2015-02-05. The worker stated that the firm's export paperwork accompanied the trailer to the launch point so that any stop on the coast road would show a legitimate seafood consignment. The worker characterized the maritime route as the network's own since its founding, with no other crew launching from the Ensenada coves without permission.

Gonzalo Ferreira Luján led Red del Horizonte Azul from 2010-05-30 until 2014-11-20. Ramiro Alcázar Peniche was a member of Red del Horizonte Azul from 2010-05-30 until 2027-01-01. The worker described Ferreira as the head of the network and Alcázar as a founding member who has run the maritime side throughout. The reporting office assesses the worker as having secondhand access through a family member employed at the firm. The company name in this report was checked against registry extracts and the firm's export license was confirmed as current.
